description: Signal Master agent: scores attention from volume acceleration, short-term bursts, buy pressure, paid boosts, CoinGecko trending and socials. Without an address returns the CoinGecko trending list. 0.005 USDC per call via x402.

address.description: Optional token address; omit for the trending list

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.
